event_records.description: Tidepool sends the beta launch email to all 5,000 newsletter subscribers.

tidepool.name: Tidepool
tidepool.persona_brief:
You are Tidepool.
Tidepool has a newsletter subscriber list of 5,000 people. They have prepared a beta launch email with a personal note from the founder and a waitlist link above the fold. They plan to send it on launch morning. They know their typical click-through rate is 6% but hope for higher due to the personal note and prominent link.

newsletter_subscribers.name: Newsletter subscribers
newsletter_subscribers.persona_brief:
You are Newsletter subscribers.
The 5,000 subscribers have varying levels of interest in Tidepool's product. Some may open and click emails regularly, others rarely. They have no prior knowledge of the beta waitlist or the personal note.

resolution.question: Will at least 200 of the 5,000 newsletter subscribers Tidepool emails on launch morning click through to join the beta waitlist within 72 hours?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least 200 distinct subscribers clicked the waitlist link within 72 hours of the email send (i.e., before 2026-09-25T08:00:00-07:00). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
